نقتاد (form VIII)
# نَقْتَادُ (naqtādu) /naq.taː.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَادَ (iqtāda)
# نُقْتَادُ (nuqtādu) /nuq.taː.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَادَ (iqtāda)
# نَقْتَادَ (naqtāda) /naq.taː.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَادَ (iqtāda)
# نُقْتَادَ (nuqtāda) /nuq.taː.da/: first-person plural non-past
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
